- **LiHua Zhang** confirms her understanding of the plan and agrees to a chat post-dinner, highlighting her openness to addressing any questions.

They plan to speak at 8 PM on August 10, 2026, to discuss the warranty and maintenance strategies further.

---

*General Insight:*
This communication underscores the importance of client support in project management and the need for clear communication between team members regarding technical aspects and client-related changes.
